verdict.rationale: Quo is a business phone platform with call routing, phone menus and an AI agent, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair axis for it. The pack never documents version history, review, or rollback for user automations. The date-based versioning policy covers the developer Public API's versions, not users' automations, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
